[EN] Chebika will be bustling with merchants again just as soon as those basilisks are gone.

People have been avoiding us lately. No revenue makes it hard to get anything done.
[ES] Chebika volverá a bullir de comerciantes tan pronto como esos basiliscos se hayan ido.

La gente nos ha estado evitando últimamente. Sin ingresos es difícil hacer nada.
